skills_considered.reason: The orchestrator supplied a fingerprinted complete HTML artifact; retrieval was needed only for figures and supplement status.
The paper validates a genetic reagent and disease-model boundary but does not mature an intervention hypothesis.
No molecule, dose or treatment proposal was advanced.
The four canonical scientific files and BATCH_COMMIT remain reserved for the operator.

group_assessment.weighting: PubMed ESearch on 2026-08-11: Aqeilan RI[Author] returned 137 records and Aqeilan RI[Author] AND WWOX[Title/Abstract] returned 64. This is a primary WWOX mouse-genetics experimental lab, but not a primary WWOX developmental-epileptic-encephalopathy clinical group. Reagent construction and bone measurements receive first-hand weight; transfer to neurological disease does not.

queries.query: WWOX AND (mouse OR mice) AND knockout

field_density.note: The knockout literature is established, while the osteosarcoma intersection is smaller and contains the unresolved positive-versus-negative mouse series. Density does not settle that conflict.

multihop.note: All 26 references were enumerated and 25 distinct PMIDs resolved; the duplicated Del Mare citation resolves twice to PMID 21731849. The two foundational papers assigned in this batch were read rather than newly queued. The negative osteosarcoma comparator PMID 19936220 already has a complete-read receipt.

corpus_crossquery.query: Where does PMID 23254685 occur, and which existing systemic-null and tumor-conflict claims does it touch?
corpus_crossquery.note: Post-reading mechanical cross-query found 16 disease-model files, including CORPUS P242 and prior mouse-model synthesis. The reading supports CLAIM 036's systemic-null boundary and sharpens the already declared osteosarcoma conflict; it does not create a neurological premise.

entries.proposition: The unrecombined floxed genotype showed no detectable lifespan or physiological phenotype over approximately two years.
entries.snippet: phenotypic analysis of these mice for ~2 years did not reveal any effect on life span or physiology different than their control wild-type littermates
entries.anchor: Results, Generation of mice with targeted flexed-Wwox allele

entries.proposition: Global recombination produces growth retardation, death by three weeks and hypoglycaemia, but the metabolic measurements are not shown.
entries.snippet: WwoxΔ/Δ mice display significant growth retardation (Fig. 3d) and die by three weeks of age also due to severe hypoglycemia (data not shown)
entries.anchor: Results, Phenotypic analysis of WwoxΔ/Δ mice

entries.proposition: The claimed tumor cells are rare and identified morphologically, limiting the strength of the neoplasia conclusion.
entries.snippet: Pockets of cells on the bone surface were characterized by increased nuclei, a marker of tumor cells, but were very few in number

entries.proposition: Figure 1 validates the targeting construct and genotype assays across all panels.
entries.snippet: The image shows the exon-1 floxed targeting design, positive Southern bands and WT/HET/KO PCR products.
entries.anchor: Figure 1 panels A-C, 3/3 inspected at 748 x 546 pixels

entries.proposition: Figure 2 shows retained expression in unrecombined floxed tissues.
entries.snippet: The image shows tissue qPCR and WWOX immunoblots for homozygous floxed animals with GAPDH controls.
entries.anchor: Figure 2 panels A-B, 2/2 inspected at 725 x 236 pixels

entries.proposition: Figure 3 confirms measured deletion and the gross size phenotype.
entries.snippet: The image combines tissue qPCR, liver immunoblot, bone immunohistochemistry and a smaller day-18 knockout mouse.
entries.anchor: Figure 3 panels A-D, 4/4 inspected at 690 x 426 pixels

entries.proposition: Figure 4 visually and quantitatively supports reduced cortical and trabecular bone.
entries.snippet: MicroCT sections show a thinner cortex and reduced trabeculae, with cortical and trabecular parameter plots separated by genotype.
entries.anchor: Figure 4 panels A-C, 3/3 inspected at 708 x 384 pixels

entries.proposition: Figure 5 shows fewer trabeculae and a small atypical cell pocket, but cannot alone establish malignancy.
entries.snippet: The histology image shows sparse trabeculae and a localized cluster of enlarged osteoblast-like cells without a molecular tumor marker.
entries.anchor: Figure 5 panels A-B, 2/2 inspected at 758 x 433 pixels; qualifies entries[2]
